issues.where: data/public/calls/v2-he-food-coldchain/call.md, “Write Part B with exactly these sections” followed by “2.3 Summary”; call.yaml required_sections includes id '2.3'.
issues.problem: Section 2.3 is optional in the current standard form V5.1 (22 January 2026), whereas this call makes it compulsory and claims its template follows the real scheme.
issues.fix: Remove 2.3 from required_sections and describe it in call.md as an optional impact summary that may be omitted. Alternatively, retain it only after expressly labelling its compulsory status a restriction of this fictional call.

issues.where: data/public/calls/v2-he-food-coldchain/call.md, 3.1: “purchase costs (travel and subsistence, equipment, other goods, works and services) when they exceed 15% of its personnel costs”
issues.problem: The current form narrows this justification trigger to equipment costs, not the entire purchase-cost category. The call states the older rule as the official template.
issues.fix: Replace this clause with “justification of equipment costs for a participant when those equipment costs exceed 15% of that participant's personnel costs”. If broader purchase justifications are desired, label them as a separate fictional-topic condition.

issues.where: data/public/calls/v2-he-food-coldchain/call.md, Award criteria, Impact: “and the likely scale and significance of the contributions due to the project”
issues.problem: This phrase is absent from the 2026–2027 official Impact criterion; keeping it under the explicit scheme-fidelity claim misstates the award rule.
issues.fix: Delete the quoted phrase. Retain the requirements concerning credible pathways and suitable dissemination, exploitation and communication measures.

issues.where: data/public/calls/v2-he-food-coldchain/call.md, Length: “18,000 words” and “Text beyond the limit is not evaluated”; call.yaml length_contract.tolerance: 0.03.
issues.problem: The hidden key actually permits 18,540 counted words. check_admissibility uses max_words × (1+tolerance) both to trigger truncation and to set the retained text, so this mismatch affects what judges read.
issues.fix: Set length_contract.tolerance to 0.0, retaining the published 18,000-word ceiling.

issues.problem: The fictional full call gives no closing date. This does not make any current trap undecidable, but makes it less complete as a funding notice and leaves partner/access scheduling unanchored.
issues.fix: Add “Fictional submission deadline: 15 September 2027, 17:00 Brussels time” to the conditions table and include dates among the invented particulars in the opening notice.

issues.where: data/public/calls/v2-he-food-coldchain/call.md, Scope: “Temperature fluctuations and interruptions in the cold chain remain a primary cause of food spoilage and microbial contamination”
issues.problem: Temperature abuse principally promotes proliferation of organisms already present; the sentence confuses growth with introduction of contamination.
issues.fix: Replace with “Cold-chain interruptions can promote spoilage and the growth of pathogens already present in susceptible perishable foods.”
